name: LadeStack
description: LadeStack brand home page — static landing site for free AI-powered developer tools (HTML/CSS/JS, GitHub Pages).

paragraphs: LadeStack is the brand home page for LadeStack: a collection of free, open-source AI-powered development tools built for modern developers. This repository holds the static website that introduces the brand — hero, tool showcase, features, and contact — as plain HTML/CSS/JS with no build step.
features: Editorial landing page for the LadeStack brand and tool ecosystem
Tool cards highlighting AI-powered developer utilities
Responsive layout that works on desktop and mobile
Client-side interactivity, including an AI demo powered by Google Gemini
(users supply their own Gemini API key in the browser — nothing is sent to a backend)
